name: Curtis Hofrock
occupation: Former law-enforcement officer (Cowboy State Daily, Oct. 14, 2025, identified him as a former police sergeant in Sidney, Nebraska, and as one of three finalists for the 2025 Platte County sheriff appointment)
background: Curtis Hofrock of Platte County ran in the August 2026 Republican primary for county commissioner and lost. Cowboy State Daily reported on October 14, 2025, that he was one of three Republican Party finalists for the sheriff appointment after David Russell resigned, and that he had served as a police sergeant in Sidney, Nebraska.
